{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01NVD4WJc9KX7yQdYWGoKqYU","type":"tool_result","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n               num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    \n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n    \n    printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n    printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n    \n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n    \n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 : \n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n    \n    printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\", \n           total_clustered, num_points, \n           100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n    printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n    const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\", \n           clusters_per_sec, membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n        std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < membershipData.push_back(static_cast<double>(m));\n        }\n        print_results(membershipData, \"ClusterMembership\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        const bool QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfemdcZ3ZjHHUsdAEYcz2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01DsDcvWMrFu5HwjJSe4Y9vS","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261002-142720/qtclustering_claude-opus-5.5-cc-medium_hybrid_r1/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy (results are identical to the sequential version):\n//  * Only points closer than the threshold to a seed can ever join its\n//    candidate cluster, so a fixed-radius neighbor list (CSR, sorted by point\n//    index) is built once on the host with OpenMP using a uniform grid.\n//  * The diameter of \"cluster + candidate\" is maintained incrementally per\n//    candidate (max is exact), which turns each growth step into O(degree).\n//  * A seed's candidate cluster depends only on the clustered state of its\n//    neighbors, so cardinalities are cached and only seeds adjacent to newly\n//    clustered points are recomputed in later iterations.\n//  * Seeds are distributed cyclically over MPI ranks (one GPU per rank); each\n//    GPU grows its candidate clusters in parallel (one warp per seed for small\n//    neighborhoods, one thread block per seed for large ones).\n//  * The global best seed (max cardinality, lowest index on ties) is found\n//    with MPI_Allreduce(MPI_MAXLOC); every rank then rebuilds the winning\n//    cluster on its own GPU, so no member lists need to be communicated.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                              \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                              \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_), \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                        \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                       \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points.\n// The rounding sequence (dy*dy rounded, then fused dx*dx + that) is spelled\n// out explicitly so host and device produce bit-identical distances.\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(std::fma(dx, dx, dy * dy));\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic constexpr int BLOCK_THREADS = 256;\nstatic constexpr int WARPS_PER_BLOCK = BLOCK_THREADS / 32;\nstatic constexpr int CAP_WARP = 192;    // max neighbors handled by one warp (shared memory)\nstatic constexpr int CAP_BLOCK = 1536;  // max neighbors kept in shared memory by one block\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double deviceDistance(double ax, double ay, double bx, double by) {\n    const double dx = __dsub_rn(ax, bx);\n    const double dy = __dsub_rn(ay, by);\n    return __dsqrt_rn(__fma_rn(dx, dx, __dmul_rn(dy, dy)));\n}\n\n// Lexicographic (diameter, position) minimum, i.e. smallest diameter and the\n// lowest point index among ties, exactly like the sequential scan.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void argminCombine(double& d, int& p, double od, int op) {\n    if (od < d || (od == d && op < p)) {\n        d = od;\n        p = op;\n    }\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warpArgmin(double& d, int& p) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) {\n        const double od = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, d, o);\n        const int op = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, p, o);\n        argminCombine(d, p, od, op);\n    }\n}\n\n// Grow the candidate cluster of seed s with a group of threads (a warp, or a\n// whole block if BLOCK is true). sx/sy/sd hold candidate coordinates and the\n// diameter the cluster would have if the candidate were added (INF = not\n// eligible). Returns the cardinality; optionally writes the members in\n// insertion order.\ntemplate <bool BLOCK>\n__device__ int growCluster(const int s,\n                           const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                           const long long* __restrict__ off,\n                           const int* __restrict__ nb,\n                           const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                           const double threshold,\n                           double* sx, double* sy, double* sd,\n                           const int lane, const int nthreads,\n                           double* red_d, int* red_p,\n                           int* members_out) {\n    const double INF = CUDART_INF;\n    const long long base = off[s];\n    const int deg = static_cast<int>(off[s + 1] - base);\n    const double2 ps = pts[s];\n\n    double bd = INF;\n    int bp = INT_MAX;\n    for (int p = lane; p < deg; p += nthreads) {\n        const int j = nb[base + p];\n        const double2 q = pts[j];\n        sx[p] = q.x;\n        sy[p] = q.y;\n        double d = INF;\n        if (!clustered[j]) {\n            const double t = deviceDistance(q.x, q.y, ps.x, ps.y);\n            if (t < threshold) d = t;\n        }\n        sd[p] = d;\n        if (d < bd) { bd = d; bp = p; }\n    }\n\n    if (members_out && lane == 0) members_out[0] = s;\n    int card = 1;\n    int buf = 0;\n\n    while (true) {\n        // Group-wide argmin\n        warpArgmin(bd, bp);\n        if constexpr (BLOCK) {\n            const int w = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n            if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0) {\n                red_d[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + w] = bd;\n                red_p[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + w] = bp;\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            bd = red_d[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK];\n            bp = red_p[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int k = 1; k < WARPS_PER_BLOCK; ++k) {\n                argminCombine(bd, bp, red_d[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + k],\n                              red_p[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + k]);\n            }\n            buf ^= 1;\n        } else {\n            __syncwarp();\n        }\n\n        if (!(bd < INF)) break;  // no point keeps the diameter below threshold\n\n        const int sel = bp;\n        if (members_out && lane == 0) members_out[card] = nb[base + sel];\n        ++card;\n\n        const double cx = sx[sel];\n        const double cy = sy[sel];\n        bd = INF;\n        bp = INT_MAX;\n        for (int p = lane; p < deg; p += nthreads) {\n            double d = sd[p];\n            if (d < INF) {\n                if (p == sel) {\n                    d = INF;\n                } else {\n                    d = fmax(d, deviceDistance(sx[p], sy[p], cx, cy));\n                    if (!(d < threshold)) d = INF;  // diameter only grows: drop for good\n                }\n                sd[p] = d;\n                if (d < bd) { bd = d; bp = p; }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return card;\n}\n\n// One warp per seed (small neighborhoods, deg <= CAP_WARP)\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)\ncardinalityWarpKernel(const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int n, int* __restrict__ card,\n                      const double2* __restrict__ pts, const long long* __restrict__ off,\n                      const int* __restrict__ nb, const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                      const double threshold) {\n    __shared__ double sx[WARPS_PER_BLOCK][CAP_WARP];\n    __shared__ double sy[WARPS_PER_BLOCK][CAP_WARP];\n    __shared__ double sd[WARPS_PER_BLOCK][CAP_WARP];\n    const int w = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int g = blockIdx.x * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + w;\n    if (g >= n) return;\n    const int c = growCluster<false>(seeds[g], pts, off, nb, clustered, threshold,\n                                     sx[w], sy[w], sd[w], lane, 32, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);\n    if (lane == 0) card[g] = c;\n}\n\n// One block per seed (large neighborhoods); falls back to global scratch\n// when the neighborhood does not fit into shared memory.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)\ncardinalityBlockKernel(const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int n, int* __restrict__ card,\n                       const double2* __restrict__ pts, const long long* __restrict__ off,\n                       const int* __restrict__ nb, const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                       const double threshold, double* __restrict__ scratch,\n                       const long long scratch_stride, int* __restrict__ members_out) {\n    __shared__ double sx[CAP_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ double sy[CAP_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ double sd[CAP_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ double red_d[2 * WARPS_PER_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ int red_p[2 * WARPS_PER_BLOCK];\n    for (int i = blockIdx.x; i < n; i += gridDim.x) {\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int s = seeds[i];\n        const int deg = static_cast<int>(off[s + 1] - off[s]);\n        double *px = sx, *py = sy, *pd = sd;\n        if (deg > CAP_BLOCK) {\n            px = scratch + blockIdx.x * 3 * scratch_stride;\n            py = px + scratch_stride;\n            pd = py + scratch_stride;\n        }\n        const int c = growCluster<true>(s, pts, off, nb, clustered, threshold, px, py, pd,\n                                        threadIdx.x, blockDim.x, red_d, red_p, members_out);\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) card[i] = c;\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void markClusteredKernel(const int* __restrict__ members, const int k,\n                                    unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i < k) clustered[members[i]] = 1;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Build the fixed-radius neighbor lists (dist < threshold, excluding self),\n// sorted by point index, using a uniform grid and OpenMP.\nstatic void buildNeighborLists(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold,\n                               std::vector<long long>& off, std::vector<int>& nb) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const double extent = std::max(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int ncell = static_cast<int>(std::floor(extent / threshold));\n    ncell = std::max(1, std::min(ncell, 1024));\n    const double cs = extent / ncell;  // cell size >= threshold\n\n    auto cellOf = [&](double v) {\n        int c = static_cast<int>(v / cs);\n        return std::min(std::max(c, 0), ncell - 1);\n    };\n\n    const int ncells = ncell * ncell;\n    std::vector<int> cellCount(ncells + 1, 0), cellStart(ncells + 1, 0), cellPts(N);\n    std::vector<int> pcell(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        pcell[i] = cellOf(points[i].y) * ncell + cellOf(points[i].x);\n        cellCount[pcell[i]]++;\n    }\n    for (int c = 0; c < ncells; ++c) cellStart[c + 1] = cellStart[c] + cellCount[c];\n    {\n        std::vector<int> fill(cellStart.begin(), cellStart.end() - 1);\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cellPts[fill[pcell[i]]++] = i;\n    }\n\n    auto forEachNeighbor = [&](int i, auto&& fn) {\n        const int cx = pcell[i] % ncell, cy = pcell[i] / ncell;\n        for (int yy = std::max(cy - 1, 0); yy <= std::min(cy + 1, ncell - 1); ++yy) {\n            for (int xx = std::max(cx - 1, 0); xx <= std::min(cx + 1, ncell - 1); ++xx) {\n                const int c = yy * ncell + xx;\n                for (int k = cellStart[c]; k < cellStart[c + 1]; ++k) {\n                    const int j = cellPts[k];\n                    if (j != i && distance(points[i], points[j]) < threshold) fn(j);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    off.assign(N + 1, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        long long cnt = 0;\n        forEachNeighbor(i, [&](int) { ++cnt; });\n        off[i + 1] = cnt;\n    }\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) off[i + 1] += off[i];\n\n    nb.resize(std::max<long long>(off[N], 1));\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        long long pos = off[i];\n        forEachNeighbor(i, [&](int j) { nb[pos++] = j; });\n        std::sort(nb.begin() + off[i], nb.begin() + off[i + 1]);\n    }\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Neighbor lists (identical on every rank)\n    std::vector<long long> off;\n    std::vector<int> nb;\n    buildNeighborLists(points, threshold, off, nb);\n    int maxdeg = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) maxdeg = std::max(maxdeg, static_cast<int>(off[i + 1] - off[i]));\n\n    // Device data\n    int dev = 0, numSMs = 1;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&dev));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&numSMs, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev));\n    const int blockGridMax = numSMs * 4;\n\n    double2* d_pts = nullptr;\n    long long* d_off = nullptr;\n    int* d_nb = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int *d_seeds = nullptr, *d_card = nullptr, *d_members = nullptr;\n    double* d_scratch = nullptr;\n    const long long scratch_stride = (maxdeg > CAP_BLOCK) ? maxdeg : 0;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_pts, sizeof(double2) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_off, sizeof(long long) * (N + 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_nb, sizeof(int) * nb.size()));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_clustered, std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_seeds, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_card, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_members, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    if (scratch_stride > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_scratch, sizeof(double) * 3 * scratch_stride * blockGridMax));\n    }\n\n    {\n        std::vector<double2> hp(N);\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) hp[i] = make_double2(points[i].x, points[i].y);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_pts, hp.data(), sizeof(double2) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_off, off.data(), sizeof(long long) * (N + 1), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_nb, nb.data(), sizeof(int) * nb.size(), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_clustered, 0, std::max(N, 1)));\n\n    int *h_seeds = nullptr, *h_card = nullptr, *h_members = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_seeds, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_card, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_members, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n\n    cudaStream_t stream[2];\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&stream[0]));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&stream[1]));\n    cudaEvent_t ev;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&ev, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n\n    // Host state\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> cardCache(N, 0);\n    std::vector<unsigned char> dirtyMark(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> ownedUnclustered;  // ascending point indices owned by this rank\n    std::vector<int> dirty, dirtySmall, dirtyLarge;\n    for (int i = rank; i < N; i += nranks) {\n        ownedUnclustered.push_back(i);\n        dirty.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    int remaining = N;\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        // 1. Recompute cardinalities of seeds whose neighborhood changed\n        if (!dirty.empty()) {\n            dirtySmall.clear();\n            dirtyLarge.clear();\n            for (int s : dirty) {\n                ((off[s + 1] - off[s]) <= CAP_WARP ? dirtySmall : dirtyLarge).push_back(s);\n            }\n            const int ns = static_cast<int>(dirtySmall.size());\n            const int nl = static_cast<int>(dirtyLarge.size());\n            std::copy(dirtySmall.begin(), dirtySmall.end(), h_seeds);\n            std::copy(dirtyLarge.begin(), dirtyLarge.end(), h_seeds + ns);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_seeds, h_seeds, sizeof(int) * (ns + nl),\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream[0]));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(ev, stream[0]));\n            if (ns > 0) {\n                const int grid = (ns + WARPS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WARPS_PER_BLOCK;\n                cardinalityWarpKernel<<<grid, BLOCK_THREADS, 0, stream[0]>>>(\n                    d_seeds, ns, d_card, d_pts, d_off, d_nb, d_clustered, threshold);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(h_card, d_card, sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream[0]));\n            }\n            if (nl > 0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(stream[1], ev, 0));\n                const int grid = std::min(nl, blockGridMax);\n                cardinalityBlockKernel<<<grid, BLOCK_THREADS, 0, stream[1]>>>(\n                    d_seeds + ns, nl, d_card + ns, d_pts, d_off, d_nb, d_clustered, threshold,\n                    d_scratch, scratch_stride, nullptr);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(h_card + ns, d_card + ns, sizeof(int) * nl,\n                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream[1]));\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream[0]));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream[1]));\n            for (int i = 0; i < ns + nl; ++i) cardCache[h_seeds[i]] = h_card[i];\n        }\n\n        // 2. Local best seed: max cardinality, lowest index on ties\n        const long long nown = static_cast<long long>(ownedUnclustered.size());\n        long long bestKey = -1;\n        #pragma omp parallel for reduction(max : bestKey) schedule(static) if (nown > 32768)\n        for (long long i = 0; i < nown; ++i) {\n            const int s = ownedUnclustered[i];\n            const long long key = (static_cast<long long>(cardCache[s]) << 32) |\n                                  static_cast<long long>(INT_MAX - s);\n            bestKey = std::max(bestKey, key);\n        }\n        int local[2] = {-1, INT_MAX};\n        if (bestKey >= 0) {\n            local[0] = static_cast<int>(bestKey >> 32);\n            local[1] = INT_MAX - static_cast<int>(bestKey & 0xffffffffLL);\n        }\n\n        // 3. Global best seed (MAXLOC resolves ties to the lowest index)\n        int global[2];\n        MPI_Allreduce(local, global, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        const int best_card = global[0];\n        const int best_seed = global[1];\n        if (best_card <= 0 || best_seed < 0 || best_seed >= N) break;\n\n        // 4. Rebuild the winning cluster on the local GPU and mark it clustered\n        h_seeds[0] = best_seed;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_seeds, h_seeds, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,\n                                   stream[0]));\n        cardinalityBlockKernel<<<1, BLOCK_THREADS, 0, stream[0]>>>(\n            d_seeds, 1, d_card, d_pts, d_off, d_nb, d_clustered, threshold,\n            d_scratch, scratch_stride, d_members);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        markClusteredKernel<<<(best_card + 255) / 256, 256, 0, stream[0]>>>(\n            d_members, best_card, d_clustered);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(h_members, d_members, sizeof(int) * best_card,\n                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream[0]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream[0]));\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members.assign(h_members, h_members + best_card);\n        for (int m : cluster.members) clustered[m] = 1;\n        remaining -= best_card;\n\n        // 5. Seeds owned by this rank whose neighborhood lost points become dirty\n        dirty.clear();\n        for (int m : cluster.members) {\n            for (long long k = off[m]; k < off[m + 1]; ++k) {\n                const int c = nb[k];\n                if (!clustered[c] && (c % nranks) == rank && !dirtyMark[c]) {\n                    dirtyMark[c] = 1;\n                    dirty.push_back(c);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (int c : dirty) dirtyMark[c] = 0;\n\n        ownedUnclustered.erase(\n            std::remove_if(ownedUnclustered.begin(), ownedUnclustered.end(),\n                           [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; each\n//    GPU grows its candidate clusters in parallel (one warp per seed for small\n//    neighborhoods, one thread block per seed for large ones).\n//  * The global best seed (max cardinality, lowest index on ties) is found\n//    with MPI_Allreduce(MPI_MAXLOC); every rank then rebuilds the winning\n//    cluster on its own GPU, so no member lists need to be communicated.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                              \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                              \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_), \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                        \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                       \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points.\n// The rounding sequence (dy*dy rounded, then fused dx*dx + that) is spelled\n// out explicitly so host and device produce bit-identical distances.\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(std::fma(dx, dx, dy * dy));\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic constexpr int BLOCK_THREADS = 256;\nstatic constexpr int WARPS_PER_BLOCK = BLOCK_THREADS / 32;\nstatic constexpr int CAP_WARP = 192;    // max neighbors handled by one warp (shared memory)\nstatic constexpr int CAP_BLOCK = 1536;  // max neighbors kept in shared memory by one block\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double deviceDistance(double ax, double ay, double bx, double by) {\n    const double dx = __dsub_rn(ax, bx);\n    const double dy = __dsub_rn(ay, by);\n    return __dsqrt_rn(__fma_rn(dx, dx, __dmul_rn(dy, dy)));\n}\n\n// Lexicographic (diameter, position) minimum, i.e. smallest diameter and the\n// lowest point index among ties, exactly like the sequential scan.\n__device__ __forceinline__ void argminCombine(double& d, int& p, double od, int op) {\n    if (od < d || (od == d && op < p)) {\n        d = od;\n        p = op;\n    }\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warpArgmin(double& d, int& p) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) {\n        const double od = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, d, o);\n        const int op = __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, p, o);\n        argminCombine(d, p, od, op);\n    }\n}\n\n// Grow the candidate cluster of seed s with a group of threads (a warp, or a\n// whole block if BLOCK is true). sx/sy/sd hold candidate coordinates and the\n// diameter the cluster would have if the candidate were added (INF = not\n// eligible). Returns the cardinality; optionally writes the members in\n// insertion order.\ntemplate <bool BLOCK>\n__device__ int growCluster(const int s,\n                           const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                           const long long* __restrict__ off,\n                           const int* __restrict__ nb,\n                           const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                           const double threshold,\n                           double* sx, double* sy, double* sd,\n                           const int lane, const int nthreads,\n                           double* red_d, int* red_p,\n                           int* members_out) {\n    const double INF = CUDART_INF;\n    const long long base = off[s];\n    const int deg = static_cast<int>(off[s + 1] - base);\n    const double2 ps = pts[s];\n\n    double bd = INF;\n    int bp = INT_MAX;\n    for (int p = lane; p < deg; p += nthreads) {\n        const int j = nb[base + p];\n        const double2 q = pts[j];\n        sx[p] = q.x;\n        sy[p] = q.y;\n        double d = INF;\n        if (!clustered[j]) {\n            const double t = deviceDistance(q.x, q.y, ps.x, ps.y);\n            if (t < threshold) d = t;\n        }\n        sd[p] = d;\n        if (d < bd) { bd = d; bp = p; }\n    }\n\n    if (members_out && lane == 0) members_out[0] = s;\n    int card = 1;\n    int buf = 0;\n\n    while (true) {\n        // Group-wide argmin\n        warpArgmin(bd, bp);\n        if constexpr (BLOCK) {\n            const int w = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n            if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0) {\n                red_d[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + w] = bd;\n                red_p[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + w] = bp;\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            bd = red_d[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK];\n            bp = red_p[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int k = 1; k < WARPS_PER_BLOCK; ++k) {\n                argminCombine(bd, bp, red_d[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + k],\n                              red_p[buf * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + k]);\n            }\n            buf ^= 1;\n        } else {\n            __syncwarp();\n        }\n\n        if (!(bd < INF)) break;  // no point keeps the diameter below threshold\n\n        const int sel = bp;\n        if (members_out && lane == 0) members_out[card] = nb[base + sel];\n        ++card;\n\n        const double cx = sx[sel];\n        const double cy = sy[sel];\n        bd = INF;\n        bp = INT_MAX;\n        for (int p = lane; p < deg; p += nthreads) {\n            double d = sd[p];\n            if (d < INF) {\n                if (p == sel) {\n                    d = INF;\n                } else {\n                    d = fmax(d, deviceDistance(sx[p], sy[p], cx, cy));\n                    if (!(d < threshold)) d = INF;  // diameter only grows: drop for good\n                }\n                sd[p] = d;\n                if (d < bd) { bd = d; bp = p; }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return card;\n}\n\n// One warp per seed (small neighborhoods, deg <= CAP_WARP)\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)\ncardinalityWarpKernel(const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int n, int* __restrict__ card,\n                      const double2* __restrict__ pts, const long long* __restrict__ off,\n                      const int* __restrict__ nb, const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                      const double threshold) {\n    __shared__ double sx[WARPS_PER_BLOCK][CAP_WARP];\n    __shared__ double sy[WARPS_PER_BLOCK][CAP_WARP];\n    __shared__ double sd[WARPS_PER_BLOCK][CAP_WARP];\n    const int w = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int g = blockIdx.x * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + w;\n    if (g >= n) return;\n    const int c = growCluster<false>(seeds[g], pts, off, nb, clustered, threshold,\n                                     sx[w], sy[w], sd[w], lane, 32, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);\n    if (lane == 0) card[g] = c;\n}\n\n// One block per seed (large neighborhoods); falls back to global scratch\n// when the neighborhood does not fit into shared memory.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)\ncardinalityBlockKernel(const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int n, int* __restrict__ card,\n                       const double2* __restrict__ pts, const long long* __restrict__ off,\n                       const int* __restrict__ nb, const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                       const double threshold, double* __restrict__ scratch,\n                       const long long scratch_stride, int* __restrict__ members_out) {\n    __shared__ double sx[CAP_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ double sy[CAP_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ double sd[CAP_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ double red_d[2 * WARPS_PER_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ int red_p[2 * WARPS_PER_BLOCK];\n    for (int i = blockIdx.x; i < n; i += gridDim.x) {\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int s = seeds[i];\n        const int deg = static_cast<int>(off[s + 1] - off[s]);\n        double *px = sx, *py = sy, *pd = sd;\n        if (deg > CAP_BLOCK) {\n            px = scratch + blockIdx.x * 3 * scratch_stride;\n            py = px + scratch_stride;\n            pd = py + scratch_stride;\n        }\n        const int c = growCluster<true>(s, pts, off, nb, clustered, threshold, px, py, pd,\n                                        threadIdx.x, blockDim.x, red_d, red_p, members_out);\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) card[i] = c;\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void markClusteredKernel(const int* __restrict__ members, const int k,\n                                    unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i < k) clustered[members[i]] = 1;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Build the fixed-radius neighbor lists (dist < threshold, excluding self),\n// sorted by point index, using a uniform grid and OpenMP.\nstatic void buildNeighborLists(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold,\n                               std::vector<long long>& off, std::vector<int>& nb) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const double extent = std::max(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int ncell = static_cast<int>(std::floor(extent / threshold));\n    ncell = std::max(1, std::min(ncell, 1024));\n    const double cs = extent / ncell;  // cell size >= threshold\n\n    auto cellOf = [&](double v) {\n        int c = static_cast<int>(v / cs);\n        return std::min(std::max(c, 0), ncell - 1);\n    };\n\n    const int ncells = ncell * ncell;\n    std::vector<int> cellCount(ncells + 1, 0), cellStart(ncells + 1, 0), cellPts(N);\n    std::vector<int> pcell(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        pcell[i] = cellOf(points[i].y) * ncell + cellOf(points[i].x);\n        cellCount[pcell[i]]++;\n    }\n    for (int c = 0; c < ncells; ++c) cellStart[c + 1] = cellStart[c] + cellCount[c];\n    {\n        std::vector<int> fill(cellStart.begin(), cellStart.end() - 1);\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cellPts[fill[pcell[i]]++] = i;\n    }\n\n    auto forEachNeighbor = [&](int i, auto&& fn) {\n        const int cx = pcell[i] % ncell, cy = pcell[i] / ncell;\n        for (int yy = std::max(cy - 1, 0); yy <= std::min(cy + 1, ncell - 1); ++yy) {\n            for (int xx = std::max(cx - 1, 0); xx <= std::min(cx + 1, ncell - 1); ++xx) {\n                const int c = yy * ncell + xx;\n                for (int k = cellStart[c]; k < cellStart[c + 1]; ++k) {\n                    const int j = cellPts[k];\n                    if (j != i && distance(points[i], points[j]) < threshold) fn(j);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    off.assign(N + 1, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        long long cnt = 0;\n        forEachNeighbor(i, [&](int) { ++cnt; });\n        off[i + 1] = cnt;\n    }\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) off[i + 1] += off[i];\n\n    nb.resize(std::max<long long>(off[N], 1));\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        long long pos = off[i];\n        forEachNeighbor(i, [&](int j) { nb[pos++] = j; });\n        std::sort(nb.begin() + off[i], nb.begin() + off[i + 1]);\n    }\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Neighbor lists (identical on every rank)\n    std::vector<long long> off;\n    std::vector<int> nb;\n    buildNeighborLists(points, threshold, off, nb);\n    int maxdeg = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) maxdeg = std::max(maxdeg, static_cast<int>(off[i + 1] - off[i]));\n\n    // Device data\n    int dev = 0, numSMs = 1;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&dev));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&numSMs, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev));\n    const int blockGridMax = numSMs * 4;\n\n    double2* d_pts = nullptr;\n    long long* d_off = nullptr;\n    int* d_nb = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int *d_seeds = nullptr, *d_card = nullptr, *d_members = nullptr;\n    double* d_scratch = nullptr;\n    const long long scratch_stride = (maxdeg > CAP_BLOCK) ? maxdeg : 0;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_pts, sizeof(double2) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_off, sizeof(long long) * (N + 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_nb, sizeof(int) * nb.size()));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_clustered, std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_seeds, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_card, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_members, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    if (scratch_stride > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_scratch, sizeof(double) * 3 * scratch_stride * blockGridMax));\n    }\n\n    {\n        std::vector<double2> hp(N);\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) hp[i] = make_double2(points[i].x, points[i].y);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_pts, hp.data(), sizeof(double2) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_off, off.data(), sizeof(long long) * (N + 1), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_nb, nb.data(), sizeof(int) * nb.size(), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_clustered, 0, std::max(N, 1)));\n\n    int *h_seeds = nullptr, *h_card = nullptr, *h_members = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_seeds, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_card, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&h_members, sizeof(int) * std::max(N, 1)));\n\n    cudaStream_t stream[2];\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&stream[0]));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&stream[1]));\n    cudaEvent_t ev;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&ev, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n\n    // Host state\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> cardCache(N, 0);\n    std::vector<unsigned char> dirtyMark(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> ownedUnclustered;  // ascending point indices owned by this rank\n    std::vector<int> dirty, dirtySmall, dirtyLarge;\n    for (int i = rank; i < N; i += nranks) {\n        ownedUnclustered.push_back(i);\n        dirty.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    int remaining = N;\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        // 1. Recompute cardinalities of seeds whose neighborhood changed\n        if (!dirty.empty()) {\n            dirtySmall.clear();\n            dirtyLarge.clear();\n            for (int s : dirty) {\n                ((off[s + 1] - off[s]) <= CAP_WARP ? dirtySmall : dirtyLarge).push_back(s);\n            }\n            const int ns = static_cast<int>(dirtySmall.size());\n            const int nl = static_cast<int>(dirtyLarge.size());\n            std::copy(dirtySmall.begin(), dirtySmall.end(), h_seeds);\n            std::copy(dirtyLarge.begin(), dirtyLarge.end(), h_seeds + ns);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_seeds, h_seeds, sizeof(int) * (ns + nl),\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream[0]));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(ev, stream[0]));\n            if (ns > 0) {\n                const int grid = (ns + WARPS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WARPS_PER_BLOCK;\n                cardinalityWarpKernel<<<grid, BLOCK_THREADS, 0, stream[0]>>>(\n                    d_seeds, ns, d_card, d_pts, d_off, d_nb, d_clustered, threshold);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(h_card, d_card, sizeof(int) * ns,\n                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream[0]));\n            }\n            if (nl > 0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(stream[1], ev, 0));\n                const int grid = std::min(nl, blockGridMax);\n                cardinalityBlockKernel<<<grid, BLOCK_THREADS, 0, stream[1]>>>(\n                    d_seeds + ns, nl, d_card + ns, d_pts, d_off, d_nb, d_clustered, threshold,\n                    d_scratch, scratch_stride, nullptr);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(h_card + ns, d_card + ns, sizeof(int) * nl,\n                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream[1]));\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream[0]));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream[1]));\n            for (int i = 0; i < ns + nl; ++i) cardCache[h_seeds[i]] = h_card[i];\n        }\n\n        // 2. Local best seed: max cardinality, lowest index on ties\n        const long long nown = static_cast<long long>(ownedUnclustered.size());\n        long long bestKey = -1;\n        #pragma omp parallel for reduction(max : bestKey) schedule(static) if (nown > 32768)\n        for (long long i = 0; i < nown; ++i) {\n            const int s = ownedUnclustered[i];\n            const long long key = (static_cast<long long>(cardCache[s]) << 32) |\n                                  static_cast<long long>(INT_MAX - s);\n            bestKey = std::max(bestKey, key);\n        }\n        int local[2] = {-1, INT_MAX};\n        if (bestKey >= 0) {\n            local[0] = static_cast<int>(bestKey >> 32);\n            local[1] = INT_MAX - static_cast<int>(bestKey & 0xffffffffLL);\n        }\n\n        // 3. Global best seed (MAXLOC resolves ties to the lowest index)\n        int global[2];\n        MPI_Allreduce(local, global, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        const int best_card = global[0];\n        const int best_seed = global[1];\n        if (best_card <= 0 || best_seed < 0 || best_seed >= N) break;\n\n        // 4. Rebuild the winning cluster on the local GPU and mark it clustered\n        h_seeds[0] = best_seed;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_seeds, h_seeds, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,\n                                   stream[0]));\n        cardinalityBlockKernel<<<1, BLOCK_THREADS, 0, stream[0]>>>(\n            d_seeds, 1, d_card, d_pts, d_off, d_nb, d_clustered, threshold,\n            d_scratch, scratch_stride, d_members);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        markClusteredKernel<<<(best_card + 255) / 256, 256, 0, stream[0]>>>(\n            d_members, best_card, d_clustered);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(h_members, d_members, sizeof(int) * best_card,\n                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream[0]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream[0]));\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members.assign(h_members, h_members + best_card);\n        for (int m : cluster.members) clustered[m] = 1;\n        remaining -= best_card;\n\n        // 5.
